- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [adoption, redesign] Pet Customization Safety Net Stage: Redesign the friend selection screen into a interactive stage layout with immediate visual verification of pet traits before adoption. (why: Adoption conversion is low (68.9%) and 3 support emails reported custom pets failing or looking incorrect.)
1: [home, redesign] Desktop Spawn Verification Checklist: Redesign the waiting screen into a interactive checklist layout that confirms desktop overlay permissions while waiting. (why: 3 support tickets noted pets failing to show up on desktop or app failing to open, and home waiting step takes a mean of 2336s.)
2: [choose_path, layout] Instant Desktop Mascot Carousel Layout: Switch choose path selection screen to a visual carousel layout highlighting instant adoption versus visual generation. (why: Users take an average of 514s on path selection; a carousel layout speeds up path evaluation.)
3: [home, wait_info] Pet Cloud Synthesis Time & Audio Estimator: Display a live time remaining countdown and audio chime trigger when desktop pet rendering finishes background tasks. (why: Home wait step has high duration (median 201s, mean 2336s) causing user drop-off or confusion if background setup stalls.)
4: [adoption, hint] Adoptable Trait Compatibility Badges: Add clear personality trait badges and desktop reactivity hints on pet adoption selection cards. (why: Adoption step has the biggest drop-off (68.9% conversion), requiring clearer value hints per pet selection.)
5: [finish, notification] Desktop Tray Access Tip Guidance Banner: Add a prominent system tray control guidance tip banner on the final home intro step. (why: Multiple users sent emails post-onboarding confused about how to locate, summon, or hide their desktop pet.)
